title: Code review
idea: Code review: A change list opens side-by-side code and anchored comments
audience: People who need to review code within a desktop surface.
avoidWhen: Only a marketing summary is needed
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic document layout through its review code priority and explicit commitment contract: Comment drafts and submitted reviews remain distinct
navigation: Code review keeps the current review code context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A change list opens side-by-side code and anchored comments
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review code; users assess precise changes
composition.priority: Comment drafts and submitted reviews remain distinct

imagery.role: Support the actual review code context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Offer unified diff and keyboard navigation at narrow widths
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the code review structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review code content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Comment drafts and submitted reviews remain distinct
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review code content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Comment drafts and submitted reviews remain distinct
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review code context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
